Definition: Shima, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: The name belongs to several men: Shimea the brother of David who slew the giant's brother, Shimea the son of Jesse, and Shimea the son of David born in Jerusalem. The Chronicler names each in his place, and the name is common because the family is large.
TheologicalSignificance: A name shared by a brother, a son, and a nephew of the king is a name that ran through the whole house of David. I hold that the men who carry it are worth telling apart, because each one stood somewhere different.
